faqs.question: What do you need to prepare a quote?
faqs.answer: Share any dimensions you have, item or pallet sizes, maximum loads, quantities, how often you access them, your handling equipment and any building limits. A site survey can help fill the gaps.

faqs.question: Can you set up a system in an existing warehouse?
faqs.answer: Yes. We review your columns, clear height, doors, services, movement paths and current operations before proposing a layout.

faqs.question: How do you calculate storage capacity?
faqs.answer: Capacity depends on item size, declared loads, system type, aisle space, handling equipment and the usable building area. We calculate it from your specific inputs.

faqs.question: Do you handle installation?
faqs.answer: Yes. Installation is included as part of the agreed project scope. We check site readiness before scheduling.
